title: ¡Así se dice! Spanish 2 (Level 2)

sources.what: teacher course site (McGraw Hill online text): Spanish II list of review chapters Repaso A-F and Capítulos 1-9 with titles
flashcard set "Así Se Dice Level 2 Chapter 10 Vocab. La cocina hispana" (chapter 10 title and vocabulary)
Bridgeton (NJ) pacing chart for Level 1 Chapters 10-11, the chapters Level 2 repeats as Chapters 1-2 (themes and grammar)
McGraw Hill program page: Level 1 Chapters 10 and 11 are repeated in Level 2

summary: Second-year volume of Glencoe/McGraw Hill's ¡Así se dice!: six short review chapters (Repaso A-F) recycle Level 1, then thematic chapters on travel, routines, dining, celebrations, technology, hotels, city and country, cars and cooking. Grammar centers on the past tenses (irregular and stem-changing preterites, the imperfect and their contrast) before the future, the conditional and object pronouns (grammar beyond Chapters 1-2 from general knowledge).

toc.label: Repaso A
toc.title: Amigos, alumnos y parientes
toc.covers: Review of Level 1: describing friends, students and relatives.

toc.label: Repaso B
toc.title: En casa y en la escuela
toc.covers: Review of Level 1 home and school topics.

toc.label: Repaso C
toc.title: Personalidad y salud
toc.covers: Review of Level 1 personality and health topics.

toc.label: Capítulo 1
toc.title: En avión
toc.covers: Air travel (same chapter as Level 1 Chapter 10): airport and in-flight vocabulary, present-tense verbs with -g- in the yo form (hacer, poner, traer, salir), present progressive.

toc.label: Capítulo 2
toc.title: Una rutina diferente
toc.covers: Daily routine, parts of the body, backpacking and camping (same as Level 1 Chapter 11): reflexive verbs and commands.

toc.label: Capítulo 3
toc.title: En tren
toc.covers: Train travel in the Spanish-speaking world: stations, tickets and the trip; the preterite of irregular verbs.

toc.label: Capítulo 4
toc.title: En el restaurante
toc.covers: Dining out, ordering and table settings: present and preterite of stem-changing verbs such as pedir and servir.

toc.label: Capítulo 5
toc.title: ¿Qué se celebra?
toc.covers: Holidays and celebrations across the Spanish-speaking world; the imperfect tense for habitual past actions.

toc.label: Capítulo 6
toc.title: Tecnomundo
toc.covers: Computers, the internet and phones; further work on narrating in the past.

toc.label: Capítulo 7
toc.title: En el hotel
toc.covers: Hotel stays: checking in, rooms and services; contrasting the preterite and imperfect.

toc.label: Capítulo 8
toc.title: Ciudad y campo
toc.covers: City life versus country life and farm vocabulary; the future tense.

toc.label: Capítulo 9
toc.title: ¿Vas en carro?
toc.covers: Cars, driving and road travel; the conditional and double object pronouns.

toc.label: Capítulo 10
toc.title: La cocina hispana
toc.covers: Kitchen and cooking vocabulary (kitchen appliances, utensils, recipes, ingredients, verbs such as picar and hervir); Hispanic cooking.

notes: Chapter titles for Repaso A-F and Chapters 1-9 come from one teacher site and Chapter 10 from a flashcard set; no source gave a Chapter 11 or later, so the list may stop short of the book's last chapter. Repaso and Chapters 3-9 descriptions are from general knowledge of the series and should be checked against the book, particularly the grammar assignments. Chapters 1 and 2 repeat Level 1 Chapters 10 and 11, so a class that finished Level 1 can start at Chapter 3. One source labels a "Cocina hispana" list as Chapter 1 of Level 3, which fits the series pattern of repeating a level's last chapters at the start of the next.
